subject: Post-call: Redwood POC next steps & success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@zenwellhealth.com>, Ken Morris <ken.morris@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Redwood POC next steps & success criteria

Hi Sarah / Ken —

Thanks again for a great discovery call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned before we kick off the POC: 

Recap:
- Primary use case: in-app summarization of care notes and triage routing for the nurse triage team.
- Key constraints: PHI-safe handling (customer-managed KMS), <48ms median token latency target for summary API, and no retention of raw clinical text in hosted logs.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm or edit):
1) Precision: automated summaries match clinician-verified summaries >= 88% (sample of 150 notes)
2) Latency: 90th percentile end-to-end (app -> Redwood -> app) <= 120ms for 512-token summaries
3) Cost: projected per-summary token cost <= $0.012 at expected volume (est. 250k summaries/mo)
4) Security: integration using your KMS + audit log exports verified during POC

POC plan (v1):
- Duration: 2 weeks (recommended window: Apr 19 - Apr 30)
- Scope: 150 representative notes for accuracy eval; integration test for KMS + audit logs; perf run on 50 concurrent requests to validate latency SLOs
- Owners: Marissa (commercial lead), Marcus (SE / technical lead), ZenWell: Emily Chen (eng lead), Ken (product).
- Deliverables: final readout deck, post-POC evaluation report, recommended production config + cost estimate.

Ask: Can you confirm the success criteria above and the proposed timeframe? Also please share the engineering contact (Emily?) and a procurement contact for next-step paperwork.

I’ve attached the v1 POC plan and a brief SLA summary for the Dedicated/Private options.

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf, redwood-sla-summary.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0189

From: Ken Morris <ken.morris@zenwellhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dr. Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@zenwellhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood POC next steps & success criteria

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Quick confirmations and a couple questions: 

- Success criteria: the 88% precision threshold looks right to us as a target, but can we define the exact metric (ROUGE / BLEU / custom clinician score)? We’ll ask clinicians to annotate 150 notes as you suggest.
- Timeline: Apr 19 - Apr 30 works for us. Emily Chen will lead on the ZenWell side (cc’ed once I put her on the thread).
- Procurement: our procurement lead is Lisa Gomez (lisa.gomez@zenwellhealth.com) — she’ll need an MSA or standard PO terms.

Questions for Marcus: would the perf run require a staging environment we host or can Redwood run the perf from hosted infra while still honoring our KMS requirements? Also any dependencies we should prepare for (service account + IP allowlist)?

Thanks — I’ll loop Emily and Lisa after I confirm with them.

—Ken

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ken Morris <ken.morris@zenwellhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood POC next steps & success criteria

Ken / team —

Thanks for the details. Short answers then plan: 

- Metric: we recommend a clinician-annotated "clinician-agreement" score (binary match on key summary facts) for the 150-note set; we can also compute ROUGE-L for an automated baseline. Will include both in the report.
- Perf run: Redwood can run the perf tests from our hosted infra while honoring your KMS. For the KMS, we need a short-term service principal/MSA access that allows us to encrypt/decrypt ephemeral keys for the session. We will not persist raw text in hosted logs — we’ll provide audit log output for your review.
- Dependencies: service account with KMS access, an IP range for allowlisting (we can provide a short list), and a staging endpoint (optional but recommended for end-to-end validation).

Proposed evaluation plan (detailed):
- Week 1 (Apr 19 - Apr 23): integration + security verification (KMS, audit logs), initial accuracy run on 75 notes.
- Week 2 (Apr 26 - Apr 30): full accuracy run on 150 notes, perf testing (50 concurrent), and compilation of readout artifacts.

Owner map: Marcus (technical SE lead), Neha (CS lead for POC coordination & success criteria validation), Marissa (commercial lead).

I’ll draft a checklist and a small runbook and share it by EOD tomorrow so Emily/Lisa know what to provision.

—Marcus
